justification: The strongest correspondence is the highly specific scheme: a top row of arched/U-shaped signs above a patterned horizontal band, with profile animals and a small rectangular sign below, continuing onto a lower shaft with a large elongated animal. The main difference is that some individual animal forms are clearer or more complete in A than in B, so not every depicted detail can be matched with certainty.
